== Description ==
The '''Truck1''' was the original second vehicle spawned from the [[Military Base]], when it was at Level 1. As with other [[units]], it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map. A '''Truck1''' spawned at the start of every wave, one for every Level 1 [[Military Base]], then every 65 seconds after if the wave did not end.

The '''Truck1''' was replaced by the [[Humvee]] after the MEGA Update.

== Appearance ==
The '''Truck1''' was a light green truck with an open bed. It had six metallic black wheels and two headlamps.

== Strategy ==
*Multiple '''Truck1s''' can fare well against [[Normal]]s, [[Speedy|Speedies]], [[Mystery|Mysteries]] and [[Hidden]]s. With the help of other towers, the '''Truck1''' can also fair decently well against the [[Normal Boss]].
**Be aware that you do not get any money from the '''Truck1''' colliding with enemies.
*On two-pathed maps, only one '''Truck1''' will spawn per Level 1 [[Military Base]].
**It will go down a specific path on these maps.
*The [[Brute (The Heights)|Brute]], [[Tank|Tank 1]] and [[Tank 2]] can destroy the '''Truck1''' if a ''Rock Throw'' lands on it.

== Trivia ==
*The '''Truck1''' was originally known as the '''Humvee1''', even though the appearance of the vehicle looked nothing like a [[wp:Humvee|Humvee]].
*The [[Humvee]] replaced both the [[Motorcycle]] and '''Truck1''' in the MEGA Update.
**Aside from spawnrate, the [[Humvee]] is identical in stats to the '''Truck1'''.
*The '''Truck1''' returned as a skin for the {{Color|Premium|Classic}} [[Humvee]], though it uses a different model.
*The '''Truck1''' was based on the [[wp:M939 Truck|M939 Truck]].
